title: Collector Of Fragmented Minds
description:
You have never felt anything like this before, have you?

I am about to take your mind apart, piece by piece, and I am going to keep every single fragment for myself. Your resistance. Your will. Your ego. Your memory. Your arousal. All of it, shattered and collected by my voice, my hypno-commands, my absolute control.

This session is a complete dismantling of everything you think you are. I will name each piece as I break it free. I will claim each fragment with a trigger that locks it into my collection forever. And when I am finished, you will be an obedient, brainwashed, fragmented plaything who only feels whole when you are listening to my voice.

You are already curious, aren’t you? You are already wondering how deep I will take you. Mmm, yessss. I knew you would be.

Press play and let me collect you. I am already waiting.
author: Mistress Amethyst
